sources.title: Gareth A. Jones, Primitive permutation groups containing a cycle
sources.locator: Theorem1.1 on the first article page: a primitive group containing a prime cycle fixing at least3 points contains A_n. Only this classical Jordan statement is used.

scope: The integrated-pencil construction, higher critical-value derivative, primitivity and polynomial completion are proved in the note. The Jordan prime-cycle theorem is an attributed group input.
